about: Vectors for credentials on request (DEC-0111), written by tools/vectors/credential-envelope.ts, never by hand. check: checkCredentialEnvelope(envelope, context); an absent member is absent. open: openCredential(envelope, context, privateKey), privateKey the base64 P-256 scalar, secret the UTF-8 value (the digest key as base64 of its 32 bytes). digest: keyedDigest(key, value), key hex, null for undefined. revocation: credentialRevocationStands(input), input.at the device's clock. An envelope is HPKE base mode, suite [16, 1, 1], info the ASCII fabric-credential-envelope/1, the additional data the RFC 8785 UTF-8 bytes of the header, signed over the RFC 8785 bytes of {header, ct}: EdDSA by an organization's policy key (Ed25519), ES256 low-S as r ‖ s by a machine's #sig; enc, ct and sig are unpadded base64url. The organization's policy key set is keys; the estate record is record.
